data.title: 妮姆芙 · 夏夜祭典烟花下的紧抱手臂
data.description: 人声鼎沸的夏夜祭典上，第一记巨响的烟花在夜空炸开。被吓了一跳的妮姆芙整个人扑过来死死抱住你的手臂，小脸埋在你的臂弯里，眼眶微红又忍不住抬头看满天金辉。
data.location: bustling summer shrine festival terrace overlooking river fireworks
data.action: standing in festive summer crowd, startled by sudden firework bangs, burying face in partner bicep with wings trembling, looking up with tearful awe
data.lighting: colorful bursts of red and gold fireworks illuminating the night sky
data.mood: sweet protective date, dependent girlfriend warmth, awe-inspiring festival night
data.promptProse: Clinging tightly to partner arm in a festival crowd, startled Nymph buries her face in his bicep with trembling wings beneath exploding fireworks.
data.animaCaption: Nymph clinging tightly to partner arm under festival fireworks.
